title: Using SQLite from Ruby

content.intro: Learn Using SQLite from Ruby through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding using sqlite from ruby helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Using SQLite from Ruby helps you reason about opening a database. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: Example: Using SQLite from Ruby
content_blocks.code:
require "sqlite3"
db = SQLite3::Database.new(":memory:")
db.execute("CREATE TABLE tasks (id INTEGER, title TEXT)")
db.execute("INSERT INTO tasks VALUES (?, ?)", [1, "Learn Ruby"])
puts db.get_first_value("SELECT title FROM tasks WHERE id = ?", 1)
db.close
